scripts.dev: concurrently -n seeder,typeorm,nest-typeorm,mikroorm,nest-mikroorm -c auto "npm run dev -w @joakimbugge/seeder" "npm run dev -w @joakimbugge/typeorm-seeder" "npm run dev -w @joakimbugge/nest-typeorm-seeder" "npm run dev -w @joakimbugge/mikroorm-seeder" "npm run dev -w @joakimbugge/nest-mikroorm-seeder"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n build,typecheck -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run typecheck:watch"
scripts.fmt: oxfmt scripts docs/.vitepress/config.mts && npm run fmt --workspaces --if-present
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check scripts docs/.vitepress/config.mts && npm run fmt:check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.docs:typedoc: (cd docs && typedoc --options typedoc.seeder.json && typedoc --options typedoc.typeorm-seeder.json && typedoc --options typedoc.nest-typeorm-seeder.json && typedoc --options typedoc.mikroorm-seeder.json && typedoc --options typedoc.nest-mikroorm-seeder.json)
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:typedoc && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:typedoc && vitepress build docs
